$comment: Per-file allowances for scripts/ci/check_fabricated_facts.py. A count may fall and may never rise; a file absent here may have none. Every rule records the owner accountable for retiring its remainder and the date by which that must happen - an expired allowance fails the check, which is what stops a ratchet becoming permanent.

fabricated_observation_literal.reason: Two cases remain. state/constants.rs declares LEGACY_UNRECORDED_AT, the v1 wire compatibility sentinel for historical Session events without a durable time; a versioned read must preserve the underlying unknown observation. official_request_witnesses.rs builds a synthetic pagination cursor whose created_at is a cursor position, not a record's observation. The Models API now reads Control's durable local publication time through the existing Coordinator registration history.
